##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 11 August 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly south or southeast, backing mainly east or northeast later, 2 to 4. Occasionally increasing 5 in the west of the area at first, then in the east of the area overnight and tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly east or northeast 2 to 4, but occasionally variable 3 or less, settling south or southwest overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then perhaps fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally very poor later.
